description: This file contains the implementation of a PSR-7 Response class, including status code handling, reason phrases, and response construction.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Implements a PSR-7 ResponseInterface, managing HTTP response status, reason phrases, headers, and body.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with the specified status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: assertStatusCodeIsInteger
methods.description: Validates that the status code is an integer.

methods.name: assertStatusCodeRange
methods.description: Ensures the status code is within the valid HTTP range (100-599).
